raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Batch 14 contains a second delivery at 05:00 that re-sends 333 rows already delivered at 02:00. The re-sent rows carry txn_ts as epoch milliseconds, which breaks the TIMESTAMP cast. The epoch value 1768716039000 equals 2026-01-18 06:00:39 UTC, the same moment as the original row. The fix is to parse both timestamp formats and dedupe by txn_id, otherwise the gold tables would double count.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.85,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH parsed AS (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN regexp_matches(txn_ts, '^[0-9]{13}$') THEN epoch_ms(CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT)) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts, status, ingest_ts FROM raw_transactions), dedup AS (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts ASC) AS rn FROM parsed) SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM dedup WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'POSTED'"}}
